$comment: Each theme's outfits: the six figures as portraits, dressed for that theme. Faces come from the agents' own portraits (src/assets/portraits); outfits from the theme's room and the mockups' portraits (05 Theme Studio, 06/07 rooms, 08/09 screens). Rects are [x0, y0, x1, y1] in mockup pixels. Generated by scripts/mockup-extract/outfits.py.
